name: @auenkr/legerline-cli
description: CLI for the Legerline stock market API (Indian company financials) for AI agents

scripts.build:
esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/index.js --external:node:* --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
